Limits.description:
Connection and request limits (`[server.limits]`). See the threat model,
entries T2.5 to T2.8.

h2_max_concurrent_streams.description: Maximum concurrent HTTP/2 streams per connection.

header_timeout_secs.description:
Seconds allowed to receive a complete request head, including the wait
for the next request on a kept-alive connection.

idle_timeout_secs.description:
Seconds a connection may go without any bytes read or written before it
is closed. Covers clients that connect and never send a request.

max_connections.description: Maximum simultaneous client connections across all listeners.

max_header_bytes.description:
Maximum bytes buffered for an HTTP/1 request head, and maximum HTTP/2
header list size.

request_timeout_secs.description: Seconds allowed for a handler to produce a response head.

shutdown_grace_secs.description: Seconds to let in-flight requests finish after a shutdown signal.

SecretRef.description: Secret reference: "env:NAME" or "file:/path". Inline values are not allowed.

default_vhost.description:
Name of the vhost that answers requests whose Host matches no vhost.
When unset, such requests get 421 Misdirected Request.

limits.description: Resource limits; the defaults are safe for an internet-facing server.

listen.description: Addresses to listen on, such as `"0.0.0.0:80"` or `"[::]:443"`.

listen_tls.description:
Addresses that accept TLS connections, such as `"[::]:443"`. Needs at
least one vhost with a `[vhost.tls]` certificate.

tls.description: TLS protocol settings shared by all TLS listeners.

TlsSettings.description: TLS protocol settings (`[server.tls]`). See the threat model, T3.1.

min_version.description: Lowest TLS version offered. Versions below 1.2 are not supported.

VhostTls.description:
A vhost's certificate (`[vhost.tls]`). Both values are secret references
(`env:NAME` or `file:/path`); relative file paths are relative to the
master configuration file.

cert.description: PEM certificate chain, leaf certificate first.

hsts_include_subdomains.description:
Add `includeSubDomains` to HSTS. Only enable when every subdomain
serves HTTPS.

hsts_max_age_secs.description: `Strict-Transport-Security` max-age on TLS responses; 0 turns HSTS off.

key.description: PEM private key (PKCS#8, PKCS#1 or SEC1).

redirect_http.description:
Answer plain-HTTP requests for this vhost with a 308 redirect to the
first TLS listener.

follow_symlinks.description:
Serve files reached through symbolic links. Off by default; even when
on, the resolved file must still lie inside `root`.

headers.description:
Extra response headers, such as `"Content-Security-Policy"`. A value
replaces a default security header of the same name; an empty value
removes it.

hosts.description:
Host names this vhost answers, such as `"example.com"` or
`"*.example.com"` (any subdomain). Matching ignores case and port.

name.description: Unique name used in logs and diagnostics.

tls.description:
Certificate for TLS listeners. Without it, this vhost is not served on
TLS listeners.
